svg.title: Two separate solvable limits of the Boltzmann equation
svg.desc: The left or upper panel solves collisionless streaming on one constant-velocity branch: f(x,t)=0.1+0.8 exp[-(x-20t+30)^2/(2 times 12^2)], with x in nanometres and t in picoseconds. Snapshots at zero, one, and two picoseconds translate without changing shape. The right or lower panel is a different, spatially homogeneous two-state problem: f-plus and f-minus equal 0.5 plus or minus 0.3 exp(-0.8t), with reciprocal transition coefficient 0.4 per picosecond. Their sum remains one. These are separate limits, not combined streaming and scattering in one simulated wire.
svg.text: Two solvable limits of the BTE
